item.title: Smoked yellow beet 'salmon'
item.description: We already had beetroot sashimi in an earlier post. This time we are using yellow beets and marinating them a little differently. This is not a replacement for classic smoked salmon, but it gives a perfect alternative that stands on its own, without imitating the flavor of fish, but giving a smoky, filling, and absolutely delicious option for salads, sandwiches, bagels, or the next vegan brunch. Ingredient Amount Example Step Yellow beet 100% 500g Brush some oil on it and bake it in the oven for around 45 min at 180°C.

item.title: Beetroot sashimi
item.description: This sashimi is made from beetroot. It has an incredibly long shelf life, a texture that is really meaty and chewy, and it tastes amazing. I use it in multiple setups: Of course as an addition or replacement for fish in sashimi or sushi. It has a similar texture to raw tuna and is therefore a perfect match for your next vegan sushi party. As carpaccio or tartare, it works perfectly as a replacement for beef.
